intro: Water of the Seers is a sacred draught given to young tauren undertaking their tribal trials in Bloodhoof Village. Drinking the holy water near the tribal fire opens the mind to the spirit world, summoning an ethereal Plains Vision to guide the pilgrim on their spiritual journey.

p: Prepared by tribal mystics, the Water of the Seers is an essential element of the ancient Rite of Vision. To pierce the veil between physical reality and ancestral guidance, the petitioner must drink the holy water before the central tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village. Once consumed, the potent draught grants spiritual sight, causing a ghostly guide known as the Plains Vision to materialize from the embers and lead the way toward Seer Wiserunner.
